summary.instrument: H5 and VL3 refitted from scratch (fit_probe, no cache) on takes 30 (G0) and 7 (G10): rel diff to readings.H2_capacity.by_gain <= 3.1e-15; FeatureProbe [x^1..x^5] on take 7 = H5 refit (prediction gap 0.0). SKIP 2400 = 0.05 s at 48 kHz, floor 1e-4 = Protocol.floor, decimation resample_poly(.,1,4): cache = fresh cut+dec of di_test (x, take 20), max abs diff 0.0.
summary.quotes: 199 quoted frozen/scratch baselines found in baseline.json, nolly_reading.json, capacity_split.json or lead 1 JSON, all within 0.005; rounding: H5 usable median 0.7979 (quoted 0.799 by harness and lead 2). Lead 2 'other G5 takes 0.236-0.29' is 0.236-0.308 in its own JSON (take 14).
summary.scratch_hp300: Scratch Wiener-HP300 numbers quoted by lead 2 (0.520 G0, 0.692 G5) are out of protocol: z scaled by the RMS of the section being read (hp(x_B) is 4.6 dB below hp(x_A)). Reproduced exactly (0.52043, 0.69189); in protocol (A-scaled) the same features give 0.2698 (G0) and 0.6338 (G5). The 300 Hz cutoff was chosen by a scratch scan read on take 20's di_test (run_a.py hpscan: 100 Hz 0.711, 300 Hz 0.692, 700 Hz 0.716, 1500 Hz 0.750, 3000 Hz 0.776). Linearity of the A-scaled probe on pair 1->7: 6.9e-14.
summary.lead4_D: Multisine D reproduced with own code: bias-corrected 0.4149/0.4260/0.4400 (G5), 0.4668/0.4709/0.4764 (G10), 0.0010/0.0126/0.1053 (G0) = lead 4. Estimator bracket: plain in-sample 0.351-0.373 (G5), LOO BLA 0.500-0.530 (G5).
summary.lead4_bands: Frozen probes in the +-3 dB bands (own windows on cached predictions) and the 32-take group medians reproduce lead 4 tables B and C to 3 decimals.
summary.lead4_schedule: Own band-FIR reimplementation reproduces lead 4: power 0.6123 (current window) / 0.7315 (previous window) at G5. Causal per-sample selectors: trailing 50 ms 0.6183, trailing 10 ms 0.5979 (better than the non-causal window); leading 10 ms 0.9411 (selector artefact). Same order at G0/2.5/7.5/10. The non-causal/causal gap is staleness of the level, not look-ahead. Trailing 10 ms in amplitude: 0.424/0.758/0.773/0.772/0.722 (G0..G10), close to lead 5 LPV causal 10 ms 0.437/0.758/0.765/0.762/0.704. Linearity of the band FIRs, pair 1->7: 3.0e-15.
